modules.title: PostgreSQL 在项目里负责什么

items.title: 软件、数据和指令各是什么
items.text: {c:database} 是有组织保存的数据；PostgreSQL 是管理它的具体软件；{c:sql} 是查询、写入和定义约束的语言。后端使用数据库连接执行指令，网页再把结果显示出来。

items.title: 规则需要按业务明确配置
items.text: 外键检查引用的用户是否存在。创建订单和扣库存若需一起提交，应另外使用 {c:transaction}。能写入不代表当前账号有权限，后端仍要检查资源归属与操作资格。

items.title: 核心能力与扩展要分清
items.text: PostgreSQL 支持表、索引和 JSON 数据查询；向量相似度检索可通过 pgvector 等扩展提供。扩展需要安装或由托管平台启用，不是所有实例默认都有。

modules.title: 这仍然不保证什么
modules.text: 数据库约束只执行已定义的规则。仍需配置访问权限、备份和恢复；同一数据库中的事务也不会自动撤销已经完成的外部付款。

lessonPractice.title: 页面只允许选择已有用户，但其他程序也能写订单。怎样防止订单引用不存在的用户编号？

options.label: 给订单的用户编号配置外键，写入时由数据库检查
options.feedback: 外键使所有写入路径都必须满足这条引用规则，无效用户编号会被数据库拒绝。

options.label: 只更新页面的用户下拉列表，让选项保持最新
options.feedback: 页面筛选不能约束其他程序的写入，数据库里仍可能出现无效引用。

options.label: 定期找出没有对应用户的订单，发现后再清理
options.feedback: 事后清理期间无效订单已经存在，不能保证每次写入都满足关系约束。

en.title: The page lists only existing users, but other programs also write orders. How can invalid user references be prevented?

options.label: Configure a foreign key so the database checks each order write
options.feedback: Every write path must satisfy the reference rule; nonexistent user IDs are rejected.

options.label: Keep only the page’s user dropdown synchronized with current users
options.feedback: Page options cannot constrain writes made by other programs.

options.label: Periodically find orders with missing users and clean them up
options.feedback: Invalid orders exist until cleanup; this does not enforce the relationship on each write.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请用 PostgreSQL 保存用户和订单，并为订单的用户编号建立外键。分别尝试写入已有和不存在的用户编号，确认前者保存成功、后者被拒绝且没有留下订单。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Store users and orders in PostgreSQL and add a foreign key for each order’s user ID. Try existing and nonexistent user IDs; verify that the first saves and the second is rejected without leaving an order.

modules.title: What PostgreSQL does in a project

items.title: Software, data and instructions
items.text: A {c:database} stores organized data; PostgreSQL is the software managing it; {c:sql} is the language used to query, write and define constraints. The backend executes instructions through a database connection and the page displays the result.

items.title: Configure rules for the business
items.text: A foreign key checks whether the referenced user exists. Use a {c:transaction} separately when order creation and stock deduction must commit together. A valid reference does not grant access; the backend still checks ownership and permission.

items.title: Separate built-in features from extensions
items.text: PostgreSQL supports tables, indexes and JSON queries. Vector similarity search can be provided by extensions such as pgvector, which must be installed or enabled by the host and are not present in every instance by default.

modules.title: What this does not guarantee
modules.text: Database constraints enforce only the rules you define. Access controls, backups and recovery still need configuration, and a database transaction does not automatically reverse an external payment.

distinctions.label: Database
distinctions.text: A {c:database} contains organized data; {c:postgresql} is one software system used to manage databases.

distinctions.label: SQL
distinctions.text: {c:sql} is the instruction language; {c:postgresql} executes those instructions and manages the stored data.
